notes.title: Update 0.17.24
notes.notes:
Update 0.17.24

Corrections
- Corrected error of challenges when completed, it will automatically restart when the car collides with an obstacle and then crossed the finish line, occurred in challenges 4 and 5.

Additions
- Added the camera behind the car, for challenges 5 and 6, the isometric camera is not very effective. This new camera allows for several variations of challenges.
- Added new muscle car for challenges 5 and 6.
- Challenge 6. Note: it is necessary to drift to get the gold trophy.

- Challenge 1, changed terrain color

- Challente 5
  - Changed camera, from isometric to rear of the car
  - Changed car, from Hammer to Muscle
  - Changed the position of the barriers to improve the challenge with the new camera, it became more interesting
  - Changed barrier color to blue
  - Removed numbered texts from the floor, not necessary with this new camera

- Challenge Select

  - Changed challenge positions to add challenge 6.

notes.title: Update 0.15.62
notes.notes:
Update 0.15.62

We listened to player feedback and improved gameplay, greatly facilitating high-speed drift, fixed several bugs, and tweaked events.

- Windmill propeller moves from Marfa runway.
- Modified Hotdod colliders.
- Fixed Hotdod automatic respawn bug.
- Improved car physics in all game modes, better acceleration, higher top speed and better cornering control, making drift easier.
